title: 2026 bull elk, GMU 681
handling: Quarters kept in a cooler in the garage; ice changed daily and the meat left to breathe.
Body pelt only (no neck) frozen in a trash bag with the air pushed out.
Grind packed in 1-gal zip-top bags and frozen.

done: front shoulder #1: flat iron, mock tender

lessons: The pale rubbery edge at the bottom of a shoulder hung by the shank is the blade cartilage, not a brisket flap.
Find the blade ridge by feel first and mark it; every shoulder cut is located from it.
Only one tenderloin came out. Get both before or right after quartering.
